systems.tiers: field officers to move to communities to register children and issue instant certificates, in preparation for a nationwide mass registration exercise

note: The Registrar, interviewed on 14 July 2025, gives the Registry's own count of offices: over 470 nationwide in all 261 districts. The document describes digital printing of certified copies at regional offices and automated registration by field teams for a planned mass exercise, but does not say whether or how many of the 470 offices enter a birth or death digitally at registration, so no fact is recorded.
